name: Speedbreaker 1.0.3
body:
See how much you've breathed. Install over 1.0.2 — your settings carry over.

- **Your breathing total on Home.** A large, calm number — "18 minutes" — with "94 breaths · 2 minutes today" beneath. A breath counts once, for the time it was on screen (up to your breath length).
- **A quieter, clearer Home.** A single "● On" status line replaces the "On for N apps" title and the breath-length notice. It tells you when every chosen app is resting until its next scheduled hours ("On · resting until 9 AM"), or when pauses need notifications. Repair states still lead with what to fix.
- **Defaults** now reads as your breath length, with schedule and redirects beneath. The Samsung battery tip lives in the Battery row. Support, privacy and **Reset breathing total** (with confirmation) sit in a quiet footer.

**Privacy:** Speedbreaker now keeps four running numbers on your phone — total time breathed, total breaths, and today's time — so it can show the total. No per-app or time-stamped history, nothing sent anywhere, resettable any time.

Download **Speedbreaker-1.0.3.apk** under Assets. Android 8.0+; version code **7**. Same release signing identity. Play Protect may warn about an unfamiliar developer; choose *More details → Install anyway*.

Verification: hosted CI (unit/UI tests and release lint for both builds, Android 16 KB page check, regenerated design screenshots). Installed on a Galaxy S23+ and checked by the owner. Enforcement behavior is unchanged from 1.0.2.
